ns2:course.label: History of Life
ns2:course.description: Evolution of life from its beginning, illustrating changing faunas and floras through time; the invasion of land and of the skies; the effects of a changing atmosphere, changing climates, and continental drift. Emphasis on dinosaur evolution, ecology, and extinction; also other vertebrates, including mammal-like reptiles, mammals, and the emergence of humans, as well as plants and invertebrates. Same as ESE 143.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Nat Sci & Tech - Life Sciences course.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one lab and one lecture section.
